ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a marine food web, labeled SHARK, OTTER, SMALL FISH, ZOO PLANKTON, PHYTOPLANKTON, CRAB, and SUN. In the figure there is an arrow connection between OTTER and the SHARK above, and the arrow points to SHARK; according to the convention that arrows in a food web usually indicate food or energy flowing from the eaten organism to the predator, this indicates that sharks will prey on or affect otters. Reasoning: The question asks what will happen to the otter population if all sharks are removed. Removing the predator of otters will reduce the predation pressure on otters, so the number of otters will increase.
